english.note: Use this when something is done in a nonsensical or absurd way; it is the all-purpose spoken choice for that.

examples.english: They spoke so meaninglessly that I couldn't understand them at all.
examples.traditional: 佢講嘢講到無厘頭咁，我完全聽唔明。
